notes: Agent M (mars inventory), items 1 USGS, 2 Mars Trek + human EZ list, 5 candidate sites. PRODUCTS = USGS STAC mro_ctx_controlled_usgs_dtms only (44628 CTX DTM products, 20 m posting per STAC description; 4511 have no DEM asset in STAC (url null); 0 bboxes cross the antimeridian). HiRISE DTMs (1262 in USGS STAC mro_hirise_socet_dtms) and HRSC DTMs are NOT listed here: they belong to agent M2 (items 3 and 4). Windowed read: CTX T01_000893 via /vsicurl/ GeoTIFF, 200x200 window, 0.84 s read, 1.59 s total, valid fraction 1.00; other products untested (null). Trek: the WMTS endpoint pattern https://trek.nasa.gov/tiles/Mars/EQ/<layer>/1.0.0/WMTSCapabilities.xml works for Mars_MGS_MOLA_ClrShade_merge_global_463m (HTTP 200, 7 KB), but no Mars DEM layer identifier was found on the portal or API doc pages; guessed names returned 404 and are not evidence. Trek therefore contributes no product here. Human Exploration Zones: Bussey and Hoffman 2016 (IEEE Aerospace; NTRS 20160001040) Appendix D lists 47 proposals with name, abstract no. and LATITUDE only; the table's Longitude column holds per-site integers, not longitudes, so lon is null. candidate has_fine_dem and dem_product_id are BBOX-BASED: a 4 km disk counted as covered when inside the union of CTX and HiRISE footprint bboxes (no nodata check); confirm by windowed read before use. CTX licence CC0-1.0 read from STAC for 2 sample items, not per item. Share of sphere: CTX footprint bbox union = 0.2016 of area (upper bound, bboxes overlap and are larger than the valid DEM); Monte Carlo (5000 seeded centres, seed 20261114): 849/5000 = 0.1698 of random centres have >=0.90 of their 4 km disk inside a CTX bbox (Wilson 95% 0.1596 to 0.1805). Candidate centres: sources are secondary unless stated; Midway has no coordinates; Holden and Eberswalde pairs are unassigned in the source.
